meta.title: GG Garage — garden & construction equipment repair in Ogre
meta.description: Garden and construction equipment repair in Ogre. Lawn mowers, trimmers, chainsaws, ride-on mowers, tillers, plate compactors, generators and DAEWOO warranty service.

hero.title: Get your equipment
hero.lead: Garden and construction equipment repair, diagnostics and DAEWOO warranty service in one place.

garden.title: Garden equipment repair
garden.intro: Diagnostics and repair for common types of garden equipment.

construction.title: Construction equipment repair
construction.intro: Service for equipment used on site and in everyday work.

warranty.title: Official DAEWOO warranty service
warranty.intro: We provide official warranty service for DAEWOO equipment.

items.title: Fault diagnostics and repair
items.text: We identify the cause of the fault and carry out the required warranty repair.

items.title: Spare part replacement
items.text: Required spare parts are replaced as part of the warranty repair.

items.title: Post-repair testing
items.text: We test the equipment after the repair is completed.

warranty.note: You can request warranty service by completing the form on our website, contacting our service centre, or contacting the shop where you purchased the equipment.

parts.title: Spare parts
parts.intro: Ask about spare part availability for a specific equipment model. Please include the brand, model and, if known, the part number in your request.

process.title: A simple path from request to repaired equipment

steps.title: Request
steps.text: Complete the form or contact us by phone.

steps.title: Diagnostics
steps.text: We inspect the equipment and confirm the work required.

steps.title: Repair
steps.text: We carry out the agreed repair and replace parts where required.

steps.title: Testing
steps.text: After the repair, we test the equipment and let you know when it is ready.

brands.title: DAEWOO equipment warranty service
brands.text: We provide official warranty service for DAEWOO equipment.

reviews.title: Your feedback matters
reviews.text: If GG Garage has already helped get your equipment back to work, we would appreciate a review on Facebook.

form.title: Book your equipment for repair
form.intro: Complete the short form. The more detail you provide, the easier it is for us to prepare for diagnostics.
form.name: Name
form.issue_placeholder: What happened, what are the symptoms, and when did the problem start?
form.consent: I agree that the information provided may be used to contact me about this service request.
form.success: Thank you! Your request has been received. We will contact you using the details provided.
